newsitem.title: FRANCE: Kabila to meet Mobutu but continues his offensive.
newsitem.headline: Kabila to meet Mobutu but continues his offensive.

text.p: Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila on Saturday ruled out calling off his military drive aimed at driving President Mobutu Sese Seko from power, but confirmed he planned to meet Mobutu on Wednesday for talks.
"No one has officially asked me to stop my offensive. We shall continue," Kabila said in an interview in Lubumbashi broadcast on French television LCI.
Asked whether he would meet Mobutu, he replied: "Certainly."

South African Vice-President Thabo Mbeki told reporters earlier in the Gabonese capital Libreville that both Kabila and Mobutu had agreed to meet for a second negotiating session aboard a South African military vessel.
A first ship-borne session between the foes, hosted by South Africa's President Nelson Mandela, ended inconclusively last weekend.
